Question: Liquid \(X\) does not mix with water. Unless obstructed, it spreads out on the surface of water to form a circular film \(0.1\) cm thick. A rectangular box measuring \(6\) cm by \(3\) cm by \(12\) cm is filled with liquid \(X.\) Its contents are poured onto a large body of water. What will be the radius, in centimeters, of the resulting circular film?
